prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Pasadena, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1086; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Pasadena, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had been waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic and had my turn signal on before I started to move. The impact threw me against the steering wheel and then the door, and I felt immediate pain in my left wrist. I was taken to the hospital, where the doctors confirmed a fracture and put my arm in a cast. I have given the same description of what happened to the officer at the scene, to the medical staff, and to the claims representative each time I was asked. I am the named driver on this policy and was operating the vehicle with the owner's permission at the time of the collision.
